INSERT INTO html (name, documentation, company, filename) VALUES ('PLANTILLA_PARAMETRO', 'MERGE INTO EMC_PARAMETR A USING
 (SELECT
  :PARAMETRO_ID as PARAMETER_ID,
  :DESCRIPCION as DESCRIPTION,
  :VALOR as VALUE,
  :FUNCION as VAL_FUNCTION,
  -99 as MODULE_ID,
  :TIPO as DATA_TYPE,
  ''Y'' as ALLOW_UPDATE
  FROM DUAL) B
ON (A.PARAMETER_ID = B.PARAMETER_ID)
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN 
INSERT (
  PARAMETER_ID, DESCRIPTION, VALUE, VAL_FUNCTION, MODULE_ID, 
  DATA_TYPE, ALLOW_UPDATE)
VALUES (
  B.PARAMETER_ID, B.DESCRIPTION, B.VALUE, B.VAL_FUNCTION, B.MODULE_ID, 
  B.DATA_TYPE, B.ALLOW_UPDATE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET 
  A.DESCRIPTION = B.DESCRIPTION,
  A.VALUE = B.VALUE,
  A.VAL_FUNCTION = B.VAL_FUNCTION,
  A.MODULE_ID = B.MODULE_ID,
  A.DATA_TYPE = B.DATA_TYPE,
  A.ALLOW_UPDATE = B.ALLOW_UPDATE;

COMMIT;
', '100', 'mrgemc_parametr')

INSERT INTO html (name, documentation, company, filename) VALUES ('PLANTILLA_MENSAJE', 'MERGE INTO MENSAJE A USING
     (SELECT
      :CODIGO as MENSCODI,
      :DESCRIPCION as MENSDESC,
      ''EPM'' as MENSDIVI,
      ''CUZ'' as MENSMODU,
      :CAUSA as MENSCAUS,
      :SOLUCION  as MENSPOSO
      FROM DUAL) B
    ON (A.MENSDIVI = B.MENSDIVI and A.MENSMODU = B.MENSMODU and A.MENSCODI = B.MENSCODI)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN 
    INSERT (
      MENSCODI, MENSDESC, MENSDIVI, MENSMODU, MENSCAUS, 
      MENSPOSO)
    VALUES (
      B.MENSCODI, B.MENSDESC, B.MENSDIVI, B.MENSMODU, B.MENSCAUS, 
      B.MENSPOSO)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET 
      A.MENSDESC = B.MENSDESC,
      A.MENSCAUS = B.MENSCAUS,
      A.MENSPOSO = B.MENSPOSO;
      
COMMIT;
', '100', 'mrgmensaje')

INSERT INTO html (name, documentation, company, filename) VALUES ('PLANTILLA_DEPS', 'WITH FUNCTION fclLong2ClobMV (isbNombreVista IN VARCHAR2)
RETURN CLOB
AS
    t_c             INTEGER;
    t_r             INTEGER;
    t_mview_name    VARCHAR2(4000);
    t_buf           VARCHAR2(32767);
    t_offset        PLS_INTEGER;
    clQuery         CLOB;
BEGIN
    clQuery := EMPTY_CLOB();
    dbms_lob.createtemporary(clQuery, TRUE); 
    t_c := dbms_sql.open_cursor;
    dbms_sql.parse( t_c, ''SELECT mview_name, query FROM DBA_MVIEWS WHERE  MVIEW_NAME = :view_name'', dbms_sql.native );
    dbms_sql.bind_variable( t_c, ''view_name'', isbNombreVista );
    dbms_sql.define_column( t_c, 1, t_mview_name, 4000 );
    dbms_sql.define_column_long( t_c, 2 );
    t_r := dbms_sql.execute( t_c );
    LOOP
        t_r := dbms_sql.fetch_rows( t_c );
        EXIT WHEN t_r = 0;
        dbms_sql.column_value( t_c, 1, t_mview_name );
        t_offset := 0;
        dbms_sql.column_value_long( t_c, 2, 32000, t_offset, t_buf, t_r );
        DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND (clQuery, LENGTH (t_buf), t_buf);
    END LOOP;
    dbms_sql.close_cursor( t_c ); 
    RETURN clQuery;
END;
cadena AS
(
--    SELECT  UPPER(''%PE_BOExampleAditData%'') cadena
    SELECT  UPPER(''%[OBJETO]%'') cadena
    FROM    dual
),  
sources AS
(
    SELECT  ''01 - DBA_SOURCE''           origen, 
            owner||''.''||name            objeto, 
            type                        tipo_objeto, 
            text                        texto 
    FROM    dba_source, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(TEXT) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%'' ESCAPE ''\''
    AND     OWNER NOT LIKE ''SQL%''
    ORDER BY name, type, line
),
vistas AS
(
    SELECT  ''02 - DBA_VIEWS''            origen, 
            owner||''.''||view_name       objeto, 
            ''VIEW''                      tipo_objeto, 
            text_vc                     texto
    FROM    dba_views, cadena
    WHERE   owner IN (''FLEX'', ''FLEX_CUSTOMIZACION'', ''FLEX_SOMOS'',''OPENSIRIUS'',  ''OPENSIRIUSWM'')
    AND     TO_CHAR(text_vc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''03 - DBA_MVIEWS''           origen, 
            owner||''.''||mview_name      objeto, 
            ''MATERIALIZED VIEW''         tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(fclLong2ClobMV(mview_name), 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    dba_mviews, cadena
    WHERE   owner IN (''FLEX'', ''FLEX_CUSTOMIZACION'', ''FLEX_SOMOS'',''OPENSIRIUS'',  ''OPENSIRIUSWM'')
    AND     UPPER(fclLong2ClobMV(mview_name)) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
jobs AS
(
    SELECT  ''04 - DBA_JOBS''             origen, 
            TO_CHAR(job)                objeto, 
            ''JOB''                       tipo_objeto, 
            what                        texto
    FROM    dba_jobs, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(what) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
schjobs as
(
    SELECT  ''05 - DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS''   origen, 
            job_name                    objeto, 
            job_type                    tipo_objeto, 
            job_action                  texto
    FROM    dba_scheduler_jobs, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(job_action) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
scripts AS
(
    SELECT  ''06 - EPM_SCRIPT''           origen, 
            scrinomb                    objeto, 
            ''SCRIPT''                    tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(scritext, 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    epm_script, cadena
    WHERE   scrinomb LIKE ''%TXT'' 
    AND     UPPER(scritext) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
regproc AS
(
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''PROCESO''                   tipo_objeto, 
            proceso                     texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_PROCESO''               tipo_objeto, 
            api_proceso                 texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_CANTIDAD''              tipo_objeto, 
            api_cantidad                texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_cantidad) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_CANT_GENERAL''          tipo_objeto, 
            api_cant_general            texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_cant_general) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_POST''                  tipo_objeto, 
            api_post                    texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_post) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_objects AS
(
    SELECT  ''08 - GE_OBJECTS''           origen, 
            name_                       objeto, 
            got.description             tipo_objeto, 
            name_                       texto 
    FROM    ge_object go, ge_object_type got, cadena
    WHERE   got.object_type_id = go.object_type_id 
    AND     name_ LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_conf_expr as
(
    SELECT  ''09 - GR_CONFIG_EXPRESSION'' origen, 
            config_expression_id||'' - ''||object_name objeto, 
            description                 tipo_objeto, 
            expression                  texto
    FROM    gr_config_expression, cadena
    WHERE   expression LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''  
),
open_statement AS
(
    SELECT  ''10 - GE_STATEMENT''         origen, 
            statement_id||'' - ''||name   objeto,
            description                 tipo_objeto, 
            statement                   texto 
    FROM    ge_statement, cadena
    WHERE   statement LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_distriFile AS
(
    SELECT  ''11 - GE_DISTRIBUTION_FILE'' origen, 
            distribution_file_id ||'' - ''||(SELECT description FROM sa_executable WHERE name = distribution_file_id) objeto, 
            EXTRACT(app_xml, ''APPLICATION/INFO/TYPE/text()'').getStringval() tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT app_xml AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto        
    FROM    ge_distribution_file, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT app_xml AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_flow AS
(
    SELECT  ''12 - WF_FLOW'' origen, 
            flow_id ||'' - ''||description objeto, 
            tag_name tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT flow_xml AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto        
    FROM    wf_flow, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT flow_xml AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
carg_masi AS
(
    SELECT  ''13 - EPM_CAMAAPIS''         origen,
            cmapdesc                    proceso,
            ''API''                       tipo_objeto,
            cmapnomb                    texto
    FROM    epm_camaapis, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cmapnomb) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
),
parametros AS
(
    SELECT  ''14 - EPM_PARAMETR''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    epm_parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''14 - EPM_PARAMETR''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    epm_parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''15 - GE_PARAMETER''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''15 - GE_PARAMETER''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''16 - PARAMETR''             origen,
            pamecodi                    proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''                 tipo_objeto,
            pamevali                    texto
    FROM    parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(pamevali) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''16 - PARAMETR''             origen,
            pamecodi                    proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            pamevali                    texto
    FROM    parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(pamecodi) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''17 - GE_CUSTOM_PARAMETER''  origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_custom_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''17 - GE_CUSTOM_PARAMETER''  origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_custom_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''          
),
politicas as
(
    SELECT  ''18 - EPM_FS_POLITICA''      origen,
            polidesc                    proceso,
            ''POLITICAS''                 tipo_objeto,
            poliproc                    texto
    FROM    epm_fs_politica, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(poliproc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''  
),
plugin AS
(
    SELECT  ''19 - EPM_PLUGIN''           origen,
            ''Tipo Trabajo [''||tipo_trabajo||''] Actividad [''||actividad||'']''   proceso,
            ''PLUGIN Legalización Ordenes''   tipo_objeto,
            proceso                         texto
    FROM    epm_plugin, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
additData AS
(
    SELECT  ''20 - GI_ADDIT_DATA'' origen,
            addit_data_ID||'' - ''||aplica_executable||'' - ''||base_entity_name||'' - ''||entity_name||'' - ''||external_id objeto,
            ''Datos adicionales en PI'' tipo_objeto,
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT data_source AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    gi_addit_data, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT data_source AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
analisis AS
(
    SELECT * FROM sources UNION
    SELECT * FROM vistas UNION
    SELECT * FROM jobs UNION
    SELECT * FROM schjobs UNION
    SELECT * FROM scripts UNION
    SELECT * FROM regproc UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_objects UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_conf_expr UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_statement UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_distriFile UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_flow UNION
    SELECT * FROM carg_masi UNION
    SELECT * FROM parametros UNION
    SELECT * FROM politicas UNION
    SELECT * FROM plugin UNION

INSERT INTO html (name, documentation, company, filename) VALUES ('PLANTILLA_DEPS', 'WITH FUNCTION fclLong2ClobMV (isbNombreVista IN VARCHAR2)
RETURN CLOB
AS
    t_c             INTEGER;
    t_r             INTEGER;
    t_mview_name    VARCHAR2(4000);
    t_buf           VARCHAR2(32767);
    t_offset        PLS_INTEGER;
    clQuery         CLOB;
BEGIN
    clQuery := EMPTY_CLOB();
    dbms_lob.createtemporary(clQuery, TRUE); 
    t_c := dbms_sql.open_cursor;
    dbms_sql.parse( t_c, ''SELECT mview_name, query FROM DBA_MVIEWS WHERE  MVIEW_NAME = :view_name'', dbms_sql.native );
    dbms_sql.bind_variable( t_c, ''view_name'', isbNombreVista );
    dbms_sql.define_column( t_c, 1, t_mview_name, 4000 );
    dbms_sql.define_column_long( t_c, 2 );
    t_r := dbms_sql.execute( t_c );
    LOOP
        t_r := dbms_sql.fetch_rows( t_c );
        EXIT WHEN t_r = 0;
        dbms_sql.column_value( t_c, 1, t_mview_name );
        t_offset := 0;
        dbms_sql.column_value_long( t_c, 2, 32000, t_offset, t_buf, t_r );
        DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND (clQuery, LENGTH (t_buf), t_buf);
    END LOOP;
    dbms_sql.close_cursor( t_c ); 
    RETURN clQuery;
END;
cadena AS
(
--    SELECT  UPPER(''%PE_BOExampleAditData%'') cadena
    SELECT  UPPER(''%[OBJETO]%'') cadena
    FROM    dual
),  
sources AS
(
    SELECT  ''01 - DBA_SOURCE''           origen, 
            owner||''.''||name            objeto, 
            type                        tipo_objeto, 
            text                        texto 
    FROM    dba_source, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(TEXT) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%'' ESCAPE ''\''
    AND     OWNER NOT LIKE ''SQL%''
    ORDER BY name, type, line
),
vistas AS
(
    SELECT  ''02 - DBA_VIEWS''            origen, 
            owner||''.''||view_name       objeto, 
            ''VIEW''                      tipo_objeto, 
            text_vc                     texto
    FROM    dba_views, cadena
    WHERE   owner IN (''FLEX'', ''FLEX_CUSTOMIZACION'', ''FLEX_SOMOS'',''OPENSIRIUS'',  ''OPENSIRIUSWM'')
    AND     TO_CHAR(text_vc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''03 - DBA_MVIEWS''           origen, 
            owner||''.''||mview_name      objeto, 
            ''MATERIALIZED VIEW''         tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(fclLong2ClobMV(mview_name), 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    dba_mviews, cadena
    WHERE   owner IN (''FLEX'', ''FLEX_CUSTOMIZACION'', ''FLEX_SOMOS'',''OPENSIRIUS'',  ''OPENSIRIUSWM'')
    AND     UPPER(fclLong2ClobMV(mview_name)) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
jobs AS
(
    SELECT  ''04 - DBA_JOBS''             origen, 
            TO_CHAR(job)                objeto, 
            ''JOB''                       tipo_objeto, 
            what                        texto
    FROM    dba_jobs, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(what) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
schjobs as
(
    SELECT  ''05 - DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS''   origen, 
            job_name                    objeto, 
            job_type                    tipo_objeto, 
            job_action                  texto
    FROM    dba_scheduler_jobs, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(job_action) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
scripts AS
(
    SELECT  ''06 - EPM_SCRIPT''           origen, 
            scrinomb                    objeto, 
            ''SCRIPT''                    tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(scritext, 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    epm_script, cadena
    WHERE   scrinomb LIKE ''%TXT'' 
    AND     UPPER(scritext) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
regproc AS
(
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''PROCESO''                   tipo_objeto, 
            proceso                     texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_PROCESO''               tipo_objeto, 
            api_proceso                 texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_CANTIDAD''              tipo_objeto, 
            api_cantidad                texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_cantidad) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_CANT_GENERAL''          tipo_objeto, 
            api_cant_general            texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_cant_general) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_POST''                  tipo_objeto, 
            api_post                    texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_post) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_objects AS
(
    SELECT  ''08 - GE_OBJECTS''           origen, 
            name_                       objeto, 
            got.description             tipo_objeto, 
            name_                       texto 
    FROM    ge_object go, ge_object_type got, cadena
    WHERE   got.object_type_id = go.object_type_id 
    AND     name_ LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_conf_expr as
(
    SELECT  ''09 - GR_CONFIG_EXPRESSION'' origen, 
            config_expression_id||'' - ''||object_name objeto, 
            description                 tipo_objeto, 
            expression                  texto
    FROM    gr_config_expression, cadena
    WHERE   expression LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''  
),
open_statement AS
(
    SELECT  ''10 - GE_STATEMENT''         origen, 
            statement_id||'' - ''||name   objeto,
            description                 tipo_objeto, 
            statement                   texto 
    FROM    ge_statement, cadena
    WHERE   statement LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_distriFile AS
(
    SELECT  ''11 - GE_DISTRIBUTION_FILE'' origen, 
            distribution_file_id ||'' - ''||(SELECT description FROM sa_executable WHERE name = distribution_file_id) objeto, 
            EXTRACT(app_xml, ''APPLICATION/INFO/TYPE/text()'').getStringval() tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT app_xml AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto        
    FROM    ge_distribution_file, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT app_xml AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_flow AS
(
    SELECT  ''12 - WF_FLOW'' origen, 
            flow_id ||'' - ''||description objeto, 
            tag_name tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT flow_xml AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto        
    FROM    wf_flow, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT flow_xml AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
carg_masi AS
(
    SELECT  ''13 - EPM_CAMAAPIS''         origen,
            cmapdesc                    proceso,
            ''API''                       tipo_objeto,
            cmapnomb                    texto
    FROM    epm_camaapis, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cmapnomb) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
),
parametros AS
(
    SELECT  ''14 - EPM_PARAMETR''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    epm_parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''14 - EPM_PARAMETR''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    epm_parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''15 - GE_PARAMETER''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''15 - GE_PARAMETER''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''16 - PARAMETR''             origen,
            pamecodi                    proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''                 tipo_objeto,
            pamevali                    texto
    FROM    parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(pamevali) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''16 - PARAMETR''             origen,
            pamecodi                    proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            pamevali                    texto
    FROM    parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(pamecodi) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''17 - GE_CUSTOM_PARAMETER''  origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_custom_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''17 - GE_CUSTOM_PARAMETER''  origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_custom_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''          
),
politicas as
(
    SELECT  ''18 - EPM_FS_POLITICA''      origen,
            polidesc                    proceso,
            ''POLITICAS''                 tipo_objeto,
            poliproc                    texto
    FROM    epm_fs_politica, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(poliproc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''  
),
plugin AS
(
    SELECT  ''19 - EPM_PLUGIN''           origen,
            ''Tipo Trabajo [''||tipo_trabajo||''] Actividad [''||actividad||'']''   proceso,
            ''PLUGIN Legalización Ordenes''   tipo_objeto,
            proceso                         texto
    FROM    epm_plugin, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
additData AS
(
    SELECT  ''20 - GI_ADDIT_DATA'' origen,
            addit_data_ID||'' - ''||aplica_executable||'' - ''||base_entity_name||'' - ''||entity_name||'' - ''||external_id objeto,
            ''Datos adicionales en PI'' tipo_objeto,
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT data_source AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    gi_addit_data, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT data_source AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
analisis AS
(
    SELECT * FROM sources UNION
    SELECT * FROM vistas UNION
    SELECT * FROM jobs UNION
    SELECT * FROM schjobs UNION
    SELECT * FROM scripts UNION
    SELECT * FROM regproc UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_objects UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_conf_expr UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_statement UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_distriFile UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_flow UNION
    SELECT * FROM carg_masi UNION
    SELECT * FROM parametros UNION
    SELECT * FROM politicas UNION
    SELECT * FROM plugin UNION
    SELECT * FROM additData
)
SELECT  origen, objeto, tipo_objeto, NULL IMPACTO, REGEXP_REPLACE(texto, ''[[:space:]][[:space:]]*'', '' '') texto
FROM    analisis
ORDER BY origen, objeto, tipo_objeto', '100', '')

update html set documentation = 'WITH FUNCTION fclLong2ClobMV (isbNombreVista IN VARCHAR2)
RETURN CLOB
AS
    t_c             INTEGER;
    t_r             INTEGER;
    t_mview_name    VARCHAR2(4000);
    t_buf           VARCHAR2(32767);
    t_offset        PLS_INTEGER;
    clQuery         CLOB;
BEGIN
    clQuery := EMPTY_CLOB();
    dbms_lob.createtemporary(clQuery, TRUE); 
    t_c := dbms_sql.open_cursor;
    dbms_sql.parse( t_c, ''SELECT mview_name, query FROM DBA_MVIEWS WHERE  MVIEW_NAME = :view_name'', dbms_sql.native );
    dbms_sql.bind_variable( t_c, ''view_name'', isbNombreVista );
    dbms_sql.define_column( t_c, 1, t_mview_name, 4000 );
    dbms_sql.define_column_long( t_c, 2 );
    t_r := dbms_sql.execute( t_c );
    LOOP
        t_r := dbms_sql.fetch_rows( t_c );
        EXIT WHEN t_r = 0;
        dbms_sql.column_value( t_c, 1, t_mview_name );
        t_offset := 0;
        dbms_sql.column_value_long( t_c, 2, 32000, t_offset, t_buf, t_r );
        DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND (clQuery, LENGTH (t_buf), t_buf);
    END LOOP;
    dbms_sql.close_cursor( t_c ); 
    RETURN clQuery;
END;
cadena AS
(
    SELECT  UPPER(''%[OBJETO]%'') cadena
    FROM    dual
), 
sources AS
(
    SELECT  ''01 - DBA_SOURCE''           origen, 
            owner||''.''||name            objeto, 
            type                        tipo_objeto, 
            text                        texto 
    FROM    dba_source, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(TEXT) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%'' ESCAPE ''\''
    AND     OWNER NOT LIKE ''SQL%''
    ORDER BY name, type, line
),
vistas AS
(
    SELECT  ''02 - DBA_VIEWS''            origen, 
            owner||''.''||view_name       objeto, 
            ''VIEW''                      tipo_objeto, 
            text_vc                     texto
    FROM    dba_views, cadena
    WHERE   owner IN (''FLEX'', ''FLEX_CUSTOMIZACION'', ''FLEX_SOMOS'',''OPENSIRIUS'',  ''OPENSIRIUSWM'')
    AND     TO_CHAR(text_vc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''03 - DBA_MVIEWS''           origen, 
            owner||''.''||mview_name      objeto, 
            ''MATERIALIZED VIEW''         tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(fclLong2ClobMV(mview_name), 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    dba_mviews, cadena
    WHERE   owner IN (''FLEX'', ''FLEX_CUSTOMIZACION'', ''FLEX_SOMOS'',''OPENSIRIUS'',  ''OPENSIRIUSWM'')
    AND     UPPER(fclLong2ClobMV(mview_name)) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
jobs AS
(
    SELECT  ''04 - DBA_JOBS''             origen, 
            TO_CHAR(job)                objeto, 
            ''JOB''                       tipo_objeto, 
            what                        texto
    FROM    dba_jobs, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(what) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
schjobs as
(
    SELECT  ''05 - DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS''   origen, 
            job_name                    objeto, 
            job_type                    tipo_objeto, 
            job_action                  texto
    FROM    dba_scheduler_jobs, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(job_action) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
scripts AS
(
    SELECT  ''06 - EPM_SCRIPT''           origen, 
            scrinomb                    objeto, 
            ''SCRIPT''                    tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(scritext, 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    epm_script, cadena
    WHERE   scrinomb LIKE ''%TXT'' 
    AND     UPPER(scritext) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
regproc AS
(
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''PROCESO''                   tipo_objeto, 
            proceso                     texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_PROCESO''               tipo_objeto, 
            api_proceso                 texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_CANTIDAD''              tipo_objeto, 
            api_cantidad                texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_cantidad) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_CANT_GENERAL''          tipo_objeto, 
            api_cant_general            texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_cant_general) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''07 - EPM_REGPROC''          origen, 
            proceso                     objeto, 
            ''API_POST''                  tipo_objeto, 
            api_post                    texto 
    FROM    epm_regproc, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(api_post) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_objects AS
(
    SELECT  ''08 - GE_OBJECTS''           origen, 
            name_                       objeto, 
            got.description             tipo_objeto, 
            name_                       texto 
    FROM    ge_object go, ge_object_type got, cadena
    WHERE   got.object_type_id = go.object_type_id 
    AND     name_ LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_conf_expr as
(
    SELECT  ''09 - GR_CONFIG_EXPRESSION'' origen, 
            config_expression_id||'' - ''||object_name objeto, 
            description                 tipo_objeto, 
            expression                  texto
    FROM    gr_config_expression, cadena
    WHERE   expression LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''  
),
open_statement AS
(
    SELECT  ''10 - GE_STATEMENT''         origen, 
            statement_id||'' - ''||name   objeto,
            description                 tipo_objeto, 
            statement                   texto 
    FROM    ge_statement, cadena
    WHERE   statement LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_distriFile AS
(
    SELECT  ''11 - GE_DISTRIBUTION_FILE'' origen, 
            distribution_file_id ||'' - ''||(SELECT description FROM sa_executable WHERE name = distribution_file_id) objeto, 
            EXTRACT(app_xml, ''APPLICATION/INFO/TYPE/text()'').getStringval() tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT app_xml AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto        
    FROM    ge_distribution_file, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT app_xml AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
open_flow AS
(
    SELECT  ''12 - WF_FLOW'' origen, 
            flow_id ||'' - ''||description objeto, 
            tag_name tipo_objeto, 
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT flow_xml AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto        
    FROM    wf_flow, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT flow_xml AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
carg_masi AS
(
    SELECT  ''13 - EPM_CAMAAPIS''         origen,
            cmapdesc                    proceso,
            ''API''                       tipo_objeto,
            cmapnomb                    texto
    FROM    epm_camaapis, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cmapnomb) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
),
parametros AS
(
    SELECT  ''14 - EPM_PARAMETR''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    epm_parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''14 - EPM_PARAMETR''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            value                       texto
    FROM    epm_parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''15 - GE_PARAMETER''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''15 - GE_PARAMETER''         origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''16 - PARAMETR''             origen,
            pamecodi                    proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''                 tipo_objeto,
            pamevali                    texto
    FROM    parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(pamevali) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION
    SELECT  ''16 - PARAMETR''             origen,
            pamecodi                    proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            pamevali                    texto
    FROM    parametr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(pamecodi) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''   
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''17 - GE_CUSTOM_PARAMETER''  origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''VAL_FUNCTION''              tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_custom_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(val_function) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION    
    SELECT  ''17 - GE_CUSTOM_PARAMETER''  origen,
            parameter_id                proceso,
            ''PARAMETRO''                 tipo_objeto,
            val_function                texto
    FROM    ge_custom_parameter, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(parameter_id) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''          
),
politicas as
(
    SELECT  ''18 - EPM_FS_POLITICA''      origen,
            polidesc                    proceso,
            ''POLITICAS''                 tipo_objeto,
            poliproc                    texto
    FROM    epm_fs_politica, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(poliproc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''  
),
plugin AS
(
    SELECT  ''19 - EPM_PLUGIN''           origen,
            ''Tipo Trabajo [''||tipo_trabajo||''] Actividad [''||actividad||'']''   proceso,
            ''PLUGIN Legalización Ordenes''   tipo_objeto,
            proceso                         texto
    FROM    epm_plugin, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(proceso) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
additData AS
(
    SELECT  ''20 - GI_ADDIT_DATA'' origen,
            addit_data_ID||'' - ''||aplica_executable||'' - ''||base_entity_name||'' - ''||entity_name||'' - ''||external_id objeto,
            ''Datos adicionales en PI'' tipo_objeto,
            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT data_source AS CLOB), 4000, 1) texto
    FROM    gi_addit_data, cadena
    WHERE   XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT data_source AS CLOB) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
formImpresion AS
(
    SELECT  ''21 - EPM_CONFFOIM''         origen, 
            cofifunc                    objeto, 
            ''COFIFUNC - Calcula el valor del TAG''    tipo_objeto, 
            ''COFIFOIM=''||cofifoim||'' - COFICODI=''||coficodi ||'' - ''||cofifunc  texto
    FROM    epm_conffoim, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cofifunc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''21 - EPM_CONFFOIM''         origen, 
            cofifuta                    objeto, 
            ''COFIFUTA - Construye el TAG''    tipo_objeto, 
            ''COFIFOIM=''||cofifoim||'' - COFICODI=''||coficodi ||'' - ''||cofifuta  texto
    FROM    epm_conffoim, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cofifuta) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''21 - EPM_CONFFOIM''         origen, 
            cofifuvi                    objeto, 
            ''COFIFUVI - Indica campo visible''    tipo_objeto, 
            ''COFIFOIM=''||cofifoim||'' - COFICODI=''||coficodi ||'' - ''||cofifuvi  texto
    FROM    epm_conffoim, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cofifuvi) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
    UNION
    SELECT  ''21 - EPM_CONFFOIM''         origen, 
            cofifuca                    objeto, 
            ''COFIFUCA - Carga info.para documento''    tipo_objeto, 
            ''COFIFOIM=''||cofifoim||'' - COFICODI=''||coficodi ||'' - ''||cofifuca  texto
    FROM    epm_conffoim, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(cofifuca) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''
),
funcExtracion AS
(
    SELECT  ''22 - EPM_EX_FUNCEXTR''      origen, 
            fuexfunc                    objeto, 
            fuexdesc                    tipo_objeto, 
            ''FUEXCONS=''||fuexcons||'' - ''||fuexfunc  texto
    FROM    epm_ex_funcextr, cadena
    WHERE   UPPER(fuexfunc) LIKE ''%''||cadena||''%''    
),
analisis AS
(
    SELECT * FROM sources UNION
    SELECT * FROM vistas UNION
    SELECT * FROM jobs UNION
    SELECT * FROM schjobs UNION
    SELECT * FROM scripts UNION
    SELECT * FROM regproc UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_objects UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_conf_expr UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_statement UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_distriFile UNION
    SELECT * FROM open_flow UNION
    SELECT * FROM carg_masi UNION
    SELECT * FROM parametros UNION
    SELECT * FROM politicas UNION
    SELECT * FROM plugin UNION
    SELECT * FROM additData UNION
    SELECT * FROM formImpresion UNION
    SELECT * FROM funcExtracion
)
